facts.fact: 一听说 Deirdre Gregory 到了大门，Dan 立刻主张报警。
facts.anchor: We need to call the police,” Dan said instantly.

facts.fact: Samuel 决定自己和 Abi 出门，把 Dan 留下陪 Genevieve。
facts.anchor: you stay here. Genny needs the moral support.

facts.fact: Abi 开一辆 Prius 载 Samuel 去大门，叙述者悄悄钻进后座跟去。
facts.anchor: Abi used a remote clicker to open a Prius sedan.

facts.fact: 门卫 Alberto 说 Deirdre 报了真名，但她不在预先批准的名单上，于是他立刻通报了 Rose。
facts.anchor: since she wasn’t on the pre-approved list

facts.fact: 叙述者隔着车灯看清出狱后的 Deirdre：头发、皮肤、眼神都和通缉照上判若两人。
facts.anchor: Her stringy hair was now full and glossy

facts.fact: Deirdre 隔着铁丝网喊出这句话，说 Genevieve 有危险。
Abi 在 Uber 车窗外抢出司机的手机，拍下屏幕上 Deirdre 的订单信息。
